note: NAV3 is linked to an autosomal recessive/dominant neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by developmental delay, speech impairment, and dysmorphisms, without typical reporting of major structural brain malformations (e.g., lissencephaly) or progressive neurodegeneration.

evidence.text: Biallelic NAV3 variants are associated with neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by dysmorphism, speech abnormalities, and developmental delay, expanding the mutational landscape of NAV3-associated disorders.

source.title: NAV3 Missense Variant in a Homozygous State: Strengthening Links to Neurodevelopmental Disorder
